title: Materium, Shifting Gem of Aurum rank 30

subjects.name: Materium, Shifting Gem of Aurum rank 30

problem: Rank 30 sits inside the game's 'not a strong hit' branch. On neutral hits it halves the damage, which is correct (as if the bearer were strong). On hits from a class that is strong against the bearer, and on forced-strong hits, that branch is skipped, so the bearer still takes double damage instead of half.
notes: Text: The bearer takes damage as if it is strong against the enemy's class. Evidence: bc_EventDamage L3951: if strength (var 0x1499c8598) == -1, else jump to 0x140e6e02e (je @0x140e6c3b9), which skips L3952-L4001. Inside that branch, L3995-L3997: scr_CritHasRelicPerk(creature, 15, 3) @0x140e6dd59 (gate je @0x140e6dd78) -> bonus = amount x 0.5 @0x140e6df72, strength = 0; then amount -= bonus @0x140e6e008. Strong path L3905-L3949: strength = 1, amount += bonus (x2). Details Matter has the same shape and is already fixed by SU-0057 (hook_su0057_details at L4006 @0x140e6e63c). Fix sketch: Reuse SU-0057's 'defender strong' logic instead of a parallel copy. (1) Disable rank 30's own block: turn the gate at 0x140e6dd78 (je 0x140e6dfc2, 6 bytes) into an unconditional jmp to 0x140e6dfc2 (e9 + rel32 + 90). (2) Redirect the Details Matter gate call at L4005 0x140e6e414 (scr_AnyAllyHasPassive(1167), your-side branch) to a C hook that returns orig || scr_CritHasRelicPerk(damaged creature, 15, 3); the damaged creature is the instance read at L3995. hook_su0057_details then gives half of a neutral hit for strong, neutral and weak hits alike. Requires SU-0057. But the decode shows a text contradiction the vet missed: 'as if it is strong against the enemy's class' fails exactly on the hits that matter most. SU-0012 covers rank 100, and SU-0057 fixed the same pattern for Details Matter, so this extends that shared fix. App note (unpatched game): Materium rank 30 halves every hit on its bearer, sourceless ones included, except hits from a class that is strong against the bearer, which still deal double damage. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | Patched (batch I, 2026-10-26) as its own patch, not through SU-0057 (so it works with Details Matter's fix on or off). The game's rank-30 block (neutral branch L3995-L3997) already gives the right result for neutral hits, and weak hits are already at x0.5; only strong hits (strength 1) skipped it. The Details Matter lookups at L4005 (scr_AnyEnemyHasPassive(1167) @0x140e6e214 / scr_AnyAllyHasPassive(1167) @0x140e6e414; exactly one of them runs for every hit that reaches the class step's end) go to hook_i_su0225_enemy / _ally: if the hit is strong and the damaged creature has scr_CritHasRelicPerk(15, 3), amount -= big_mult(amount, 0.75) and strength = 0 (marked weak, as the neutral branch does), then the original lookup runs. With Details Matter as well, SU-0057's cut sees strength 0 and cuts nothing, so the two don't stack (same as the game's neutral case). Strong-hit variants other than x2 are treated as x2, as in SU-0057.

release_notes.effect: Materium, Shifting Gem of Aurum (relic, rank 30)
release_notes.intended: The bearer takes damage as if it is strong against the enemy's class.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, this only worked on hits from a neutral class (halved). Hits from a class that is strong against the bearer still dealt double damage.
release_notes.fix: Now hits from a class that is strong against the bearer also end at half of a neutral hit, as if the bearer were strong against the attacker.
